summary: Produced compilable TikZ (version 2, best version) reconstructing the figure: trapezoid A-B-C-D with AB ∥ CD and BC ∥ AD (solid edges), E on segment AD, with BE and CE drawn as solid edges. Labels A, B, C, D, E are bound to CV-measured points. Compiles and passes topology check; Critic score 0.95, must_repair false, no open issues. Version 1 had a medium label-clearance issue at E, fixed in version 2 by moving the label to below right.
